newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Selecta soars 30.51 pct in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Selecta soars 30.51 pct in Manila.

text.p: Selecta Dairy Products Inc soared by 30.51 percent, or by 36 centavos, to 1.54 pesos in late Manila trade on market rumours its parent RFM Corp is buying back stocks of its subsidiaries, brokers said.
"Talks that RFM is buying shares of Selecta and its other subsidiaries through friendly brokers boosted prices of the RFM group of companies," said one broker.
An official of RFM, however, flatly denied the rumour.

"We are not buying, that is not our style. Besides we are not allowed to buy back unless there is approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission," RFM spokesman B.J. Sebastian told Reuters by phone.

RFM's meat processing arm Swift Foods Inc also jumped by 8.89 percent, or by 16 centavos, to 1.96 pesos, while its softdrinks arm Cosmos Bottling Corp jumped 7.78 percent, or by 35 centavos, to 4.85 pesos.
RFM's shares also rose by 7.5 percent, or by 30 centavos, to 4.30 pesos.
